utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Glad to hear it—if you hear where they still need help, pass it my way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’m usually a bit late, but once I hear what still needs fixing, I’ll pass it along and help out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane — I’d appreciate that. I’m still catching up, so any updates you hear would be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors and check who’s free this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — could you let me know who’s available and where they can meet us? I’m keeping track of the locations for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check who’s available and send you the meeting locations as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll start with the old gate and see what’s going on. If I need anything extra, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — appreciate it. I’ll bring over the lamp and broken drill, and let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll take a look at the gate first, then we can sort out the lamp and drill after that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m on my way later—just point me to the sorting table when I arrive, and I’ll help with the truck too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll point you to the sorting table when you get here, and thanks for helping with the truck too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks Vik — I’ll head over later and get started at the sorting table.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the sign-ups covered, and I’m still checking our supply stash to see what we need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, do you need anything else from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: If you could keep an eye out for any extra tape, gloves, or basic tools, that’d be a big help. I’ll let you know if I spot anything else we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word to a few more neighbors today and see who can help this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m still checking which spot would be easiest for everyone to reach, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear something.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — once you pick the easiest spot, I’ll keep reaching out and rally a few more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes please — let’s sort the list by urgent, easy, and wait-list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds sensible to me — I’d keep the urgent ones first, then the easy drops, and leave the wait-list for later when it’s less crowded.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — let’s start with the urgent repairs and make a quick helper list for each one.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still rounding up a few more volunteers and sorting the tool list, but it’s coming together nicely.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — once the tool list is confirmed, I can check what still needs repairing and help coordinate from there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a huge help, Hana—once the tool list’s set, I’ll send you the latest so you can match it up with what still needs repair.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey — I’m ready to keep the repair drive organized. Do you want to start with the repair list or the outreach?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can start with the repair list. What do you want me to look at first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — let’s list the repairs first, then we can sort them by urgent, easy, and wait-list. If you note any tools or special skills needed, I’ll match neighbors to them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Late afternoon still looks like the best bet—should be calmer and easier to park. I’ll let you know if it starts thinning out sooner.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good, Tess — late afternoon should work well. Thanks for keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep an eye on it and let you know if it clears out earlier. Hope the timing works out well for you!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you narrowed down the easiest spot yet? I’d like to let people know as soon as possible.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, but I’m keeping it simple: I’ll check the likely spots this afternoon and tell you the easiest one first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — please do, and let me know by tomorrow if you can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Around 6 pm still works for me — just let me know if you need a different time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 6 pm works for me too — I’ll be there and I can adjust if needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you at 6 then — thanks for being flexible.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and invite a few more neighbors today. We can make this repair drive feel like a real block effort.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really going to keep spreading the word and invite a few more neighbors today?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes — I’m on it, and I’ll invite a few more neighbors today too. Let’s make this repair drive feel like a real block effort.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking which spot seems easiest for everyone to reach. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear something while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — keep me posted, and I’ll let the neighbors know which spot we settle on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll check around and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Rey — I’ll bring the small checklist and we can sort the tools first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll bring the gloves, a hammer, and some screws.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — that covers the basics. I’ll make sure the checklist is ready, and we can start there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the repair list first so I know exactly what needs fixing, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana — once you’ve got the list, just send me the timing and handoff details so I can work it around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — I’ll confirm the repair list first, then send you the timing and handoff details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I was thinking around 6 pm—does that work for the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, 6 pm should work for the drop-off. If you hear where they still need help, pass it my way—I’d like to help once it starts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still gathering a few more volunteers and sorting the tool list, but it’s coming together nicely.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—send me the tool list when it’s ready, and I’ll help out. I might join a bit late, but I’ll pitch in once I know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the tool list as soon as it’s ready, and late help is still a big help. Thanks for pitching in!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, I think I’ve got that old lamp and maybe a broken drill I can bring by. Thanks for the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds useful—late afternoon should be easier for dropping it off, and parking will be less of a hassle then too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Late afternoon works for me—thanks, Pia. I’ll bring the lamp and drill by then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — could you head to the community center parking lot and meet me at the east entrance?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’m on my way to the east entrance now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Leo — I’ll meet you at the east entrance.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would mean a lot, Sam. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’m glad to help spread the word. Just tell me what message you want me to pass along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe just say it’s a neighborhood repair drive and every bit of help matters. I really appreciate you doing this, Sam.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Late afternoon still seems like the best bet—things should be calmer and parking easier. I’ll let you know if it starts clearing out before then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That works for me—late afternoon sounds easiest. Just let me know if anything changes so I can tell everyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll keep an eye on it and pass along any changes. If it starts thinning out earlier, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks — I’m still planning to come by later and help sort and load. Just point me to the spot when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — when you get here, head to the garage and I’ll show you where the supplies are stacked.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — garage it is. I’ll come by later and help sort and load, and you can point me to the supplies when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll take a look at the old gate first and bring the basic tools. If anything else comes up, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. I’ll keep you posted if anything else comes up and share the handoff details once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll be ready when you send the handoff details.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
